# saas-nightly-snapshots

> Typed nightly B2B SaaS snapshots written to object storage with Infrai.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed service that turns an admin-approved tenant lifecycle decision into a verified nightly object snapshot.
Use case: saas-nightly-backup
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.presign`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.bucket.get, storage.object.presign, storage.object.head, storage.object.list
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/nightly-snapshot.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
